config.selection: Frozen after exploratory v4 sweep, before any real llama GPU result. Include ASTC-best tile and at T2048 separately buffer-best tile.
config.correctness: V4 gate <=1e-4 own-ref relative L2; llama preregistered gate <=1e-3 relative L2 and scaled max-abs, no fallback and no pipeline compilation during timed rounds. Q unchanged. Baseline F16 base must exactly match hardware readback rounded to F16 by hashes.
config.scope: Same FP32 Q and common hardware-reconstructed K/V base. Q4 requantizes that base, so this is a systems/correctness comparison, not codec-quality evidence. Both report one host submission through completed GPU work, with no timed output readback; their framework/dispatch overhead remains included. Reused one-query cache. T2048/T8192 repeat original blocks, not fresh long contexts. No whole-model or bandwidth claim. Unsupported mixed K/V is reported, never silently replaced.
config.negative_outcome: ASTC does not beat official fused quantized attention or results are dominated by host overhead; retain outcome. No comparison of batched GPU time against host latency.
